datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Cameroon. Geographic data representing IPC classification scenarios were compiled for medium-term projections in 2022, with spatial boundaries and classification values recorded for January and February periods.
